measurementStatus: NOT_EXECUTED; planned F5 state does not yet exist; no DB/SSH query in this task
sourceStorageModel: 59f has filesystem batch manifests/journal, not an invented SQL rotation-batches table
authoritativeInputs: exact current F5 private-state/tenant/epoch/active Node set and current public CA/control/node leaves/policies
complete F5-owned append-only registry of every prepare/recovery output path and its batch.json, per-Node rotation.json and hashes; include .next or orphan outputs
registered CP signed commit receipt directories and verified per-Node finalization receipts/journals; include recovery/abandonment evidence
tenant-scoped actual channels and epoch from one READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ database snapshot
completenessRule: all batch outputs must be registered before use; an unregistered output, inaccessible root, unsafe path, parse/digest/signature mismatch, missing receipt, unknown lifecycle or concurrent writer makes the result BLOCKED/UNKNOWN, never zero

classification.journalAbsent: only candidate no-active-batch; still enumerate complete registered artifacts and validate actual current channel/public-policy consistency
classification.prepared: count as uncommitted even stagedNodeIds is empty or overlap expired; no automatic abandonment
classification.staging: count as uncommitted regardless number of staged Nodes
classification.staged: count as uncommitted even every Node is staged; shared CP switch/commit is still missing
classification.switched: candidate committed only; require digest/tenant/epoch/set binding, actual CP next-leaf fingerprint, all target channel versions/certificates/enabled bits, valid CP-signed per-Node committed receipts, and finalized same-batch Node journals with restartRequired=false and final one-CP peer policies; otherwise block
classification.historicalClosed: only a hash-bound verified terminal commit/finalization evidence chain or repository-verified expired-entirely-unstaged abandonment record with matching batch digest may close a historical output; a prepared archive filename alone is not proof
classification.orphansOrOtherPhases: block and preserve, including .next, unknown/malformed journal, missing registered root or standalone unresolved rotation; do not delete/recover/force to obtain zero

acceptancePredicate: snapshotComplete AND readOnly=on AND exactF5Context AND preparedOrStagedUncommittedBatchCount==0 AND unfinalizedCommittedBatchCount==0 AND unknownCount==0 AND liveRotationWriterCount==0 AND CP/Node locksAbsent AND valid current final policies AND pre/post input hashes stable
concurrency: admit append only under a reviewed single-owner F5 execution exclusion; do not claim 59f init atomically fences rotation; a concurrent writer invalidates snapshot and blocks append
queryReceiptRequired: start/end KST and exact F5 source/state/DB namespace hashes, requested tenant/epoch
read-only transaction and every command direct exit
complete registry and before/after file hashes, all counts and unknowns
actual channel/CP/Node proof digests and signed terminal/finalization bindings
append decision and owner; never label a planned query as measured
